name: Fear
overview: Scripture reveals that fear is a complex emotion deeply connected to our relationship with God, as seen when Adam and Eve hid from the Lord's presence after sinning (Genesis 3:8). Fear of God is portrayed as reverence and trust, demonstrated by Abraham's obedience in offering Isaac and Joseph's declaration of fearing God (Genesis 22:12; 42:18). Jacob’s experience shows that fear can also be awe and recognition of God's holiness, acknowledging the place as the house of God (Genesis 28:16-17). This fear is not mere terror but a profound respect that influences actions and attitudes toward God and others.
